Snapshot integrity

Replay verified
The model state was rebuilt by replaying the original repository engine from seed 4242, applying the recorded candidate-node-12 lesion after step 475, then checking every field of all 59,876 rows against the CSV. There were zero mismatches at the export precision. The embedded checkpoint includes exact signed weights, per-edge delays, both readouts, soma/vector/memory/glial states, activity histories, lesion mask, rewiring count and every RNG state. The live sandbox continues from that checkpoint using the same update equations.
